Container.Name: subranker
Container.Overview:
A Stremio subtitle addon that sits in front of the subtitle addons you already use, rather than replacing them.
It queries them together and ranks what comes back against the release you are actually playing, so the subtitle that fits is first instead of somewhere in a list of forty. Along the way it drops candidates that no longer download, and repairs the ones that are fixable: constant timing offsets and framerate drift, mojibake, injected advertising, and cues that overlap so two speakers get drawn on top of each other.
Stateless, so there is no appdata share to map and nothing to back up. All settings are environment variables, or you can carry them in the install link generated by the WebUI.
UPSTREAM_BASE is the only required setting: the base URL of a subtitle addon, without the trailing /manifest.json. Several may be given, comma separated.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: stremio subtitles subtitle addon srt opensubtitles sync
Container.Requires: Outbound internet access, and a subtitle addon URL to rank.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: HTTP port for the setup page and the addon itself.

Config.Name: Upstream subtitle addons
Config.Description: Required. Base URLs of the subtitle addons to rank, comma separated, each without the trailing /manifest.json. Masked because addon URLs often embed an API key.

Config.Name: Bind address
Config.Description: Leave as 0.0.0.0 so the container is reachable from outside itself.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address this instance is reached at, for example https://subs.example.com. Required before timing repair can work, since corrected subtitles are served from here.

Config.Name: Fix timing
Config.Description: Serve timing-corrected subtitles in place of ones that run late or drift. Needs Public URL set first, or it does nothing.

Config.Name: Maximum results
Config.Description: How many subtitles to return. 0 returns all of them. A short list is easier to use on clients that label every row identically.

Config.Name: Separate overlapping lines
Config.Description: Merge cues that share screen time, so two speakers are not drawn on top of each other.

Config.Name: Repair scanning errors
Config.Description: Fix characters that optical recognition confuses, such as l for I.

Config.Name: Push signs-only tracks down
Config.Description: Rank forced tracks below full subtitles.

Config.Name: Remove sound descriptions
Config.Description: Strip [DOOR CREAKS] and speaker labels, turning an SDH track into an ordinary subtitle. Off by default because it rewrites dialogue.

Config.Name: Cache TTL
Config.Description: Seconds to cache a computed response.
